simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to חֹמֶשׁ (H2570) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: חֹמֶשׁ (chômesh) means the abdomen (as obese) First listed occurrence: 2Sam 2 23.

definitions.full: H2570. chomesh II. חֹ֫מֶשׁ noun masculine belly (Aramaic ) — הַחֹמֶשׁ 2Sam 2:23 3 t.; אלהֿח ֗֗֗ ׳וַיַּכֵּהוּ 2:23 and he smote him in the belly ; 20:10 + 4:6 , read וַתִּישָׁ֑ן וַתָּ֫נָם and she slumbered and slept ᵐ5 We Dr.; yet corruption difficult to explain, see Klo; הח שָׁם ׳וַיַּכֵּהוּ 3:27 (where probably insert אלֿ compare Dr). IV. חמשׁ (√ of following; meaning dubious; perhaps compare Arabic army , Sabean חֿמס men of a tribe who can bear arms; √ then possibly = I. חמשׁ (e.g. army as composed of five parts ) see Lane Frey; also SabDenkm 24 , which cities tribus (from tres), quartier (from quartus, quatuor ); > Thes MV and others who compare Arabic be firm strong , be courageous , etc.)
